game.title: Hyrule Warriors: Age of Imprisonment
game.developer: Koei Tecmo (AAA Games Studio / Omega Force)
game.notes: Genesis Mode — Switch 2-exclusive, no native achievement list exists anywhere. This game only has FREE post-launch content updates, not paid DLC, so no `dlc` bonus list is included (unlike Hyrule Warriors and Breath of the Wild earlier this session, both of which had real paid Expansion Passes). This was the newest and least-documented game researched this session; a proactive re-verification pass (after the initial 3-scout research hit severe tool-access friction) resolved the full 19-character playable roster, the 6-chapter/28-battle campaign structure, and a boss-naming correction — the initial brief assumed 'Archfiend' was an official 4-member boss category, but it's actually just a one-time chapter title; the real recurring boss cluster is four 'Grim-'-prefixed named bosses (Grimgera, Grimtorok, Grimgohma, Grimgibdo). Two facts remain unconfirmed even after re-verification and are deliberately not assumed: whether an in-game Medal List/achievement system or an overall completion-percentage tracker exists (both lean absent but aren't conclusively proven so — no trophy depends on either). No trophy references a discrete numeric counter for roster recruitment or battle completion since none was confirmed to exist — 'recruit everyone'/'complete every battle' trophies instead verify via visual menu-completion state (no locked slots remaining). No trophy references Phantom Ganon or 'Forbidden Difficulty,' since these are tied to a second free content update whose release status as of the research date is unconfirmed — including them would risk citing content some players may not yet have. No trophy requires the cross-save bonus weapons (from Age of Calamity or Tears of the Kingdom save data) or amiibo, since both require external ownership beyond this game itself, consistent with the precedent set for similar content earlier this session.

trophies.name: To the Great Plateau
trophies.description: Complete the opening battle, "To the Great Plateau," beginning the war against Ganondorf.
trophies.verification: The battle is marked cleared on the battle-select screen.

trophies.name: New Ally
trophies.description: Recruit a playable character beyond your starting roster for the first time.
trophies.verification: The new character appears as a selectable slot on the roster screen.

trophies.name: Scout's Honor
trophies.description: Complete a Scouting Challenge to recruit an optional character.
trophies.verification: The recruited character appears as a selectable slot on the roster screen after the Scouting Challenge is cleared.

trophies.name: Sync Strike
trophies.description: Perform a Sync Strike for the first time.
trophies.verification: The Sync Strike animation triggers when nearby characters' Sync gauges are full.

trophies.name: First Steps of Power
trophies.description: Upgrade a weapon or character using collected resources for the first time.
trophies.verification: The upgrade is reflected in the weapon or character menu.

trophies.name: Camp Support
trophies.description: Submit materials at a camp for the first time.
trophies.verification: The camp confirms the materials were received and grants its performance buff.

trophies.name: Two Champions
trophies.description: Clear a battle in local 2-player co-op.
trophies.verification: The battle is cleared while a second controller actively controls a separate character in split-screen.

trophies.name: Grimgera's Fall
trophies.verification: Grimgera's defeat triggers the battle's clear cutscene.

trophies.name: Grimtorok's Fall
trophies.verification: Grimtorok's defeat triggers the battle's clear cutscene.

trophies.name: Grimgohma's Fall
trophies.verification: Grimgohma's defeat triggers the battle's clear cutscene.

trophies.name: Grimgibdo's Fall
trophies.verification: Grimgibdo's defeat triggers the battle's clear cutscene.

trophies.name: The Battle of Hyrule Castle
trophies.description: Complete the battle "The Battle of Hyrule Castle."
trophies.verification: The battle is marked cleared on the battle-select screen.

trophies.name: Trial by Fire
trophies.description: Clear a battle on the highest standard difficulty setting.
trophies.verification: The battle is cleared with the highest standard difficulty option selected in the Options menu.

trophies.name: The Demon King, Ensnared
trophies.description: Complete the battle "The Demon King, Ensnared."
trophies.verification: The battle is marked cleared on the battle-select screen.

trophies.name: A Clash of Constructs
trophies.description: Complete "A Clash of Constructs," the game's final battle.
trophies.verification: The battle is marked cleared, and the credits roll.

trophies.name: Full Company
trophies.verification: The roster screen shows every character slot filled, with none locked.

trophies.name: Champion of Hyrule
trophies.description: Complete every battle in the game.
trophies.verification: No battle remains locked or incomplete on the battle-select screen.
